name: ExAero GR frameset

editorial.verdict: One of the closest practical matches for an aero, relatively light, very-wide-clearance build, but it remains a purpose-built race-gravel chassis rather than a road-geometry frame.
caveats: Size-54 geometry uses 423 mm chainstays and a 1,016 mm wheelbase; do not label it literal road geometry

purchase_route: Current SEKA official online store lists the exact ExAero GR frameset at US$3,299 with Shop Now for the US and Canada. For mainland China, use SEKA official support or an authorized dealer and confirm selected size, finish, cockpit, delivery, tax and warranty handling.
